```{r Step 1: Set Up GSSR Call, include=TRUE}
GSS_START_YEAR <- 2000 
GSS_END_YEAR <- 2024

# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# 3. Requested GSS variables 
# ------------------------------------------------------------ 
# Keep these in the same conceptual groups used in the research design. All names are converted to lowercase because gssr's # cumulative data use lowercase variable names.

gss_variables <- c( 
# ---------------------------------------------------------- 
# Employment / job characteristics  
# ---------------------------------------------------------- 
"OCC10", "SATJOB", "JOBFIND", "JOBLOSE", "WEEKSWRK", "YOUSUP", "INDUS10", "WRKSTAT", "HRS1", "RICHWORK", "AIWORRY",


# ----------------------------------------------------------

gss_variables <- gss_variables |> stringr::str_to_lower() |> unique()
```


```{r Step 2, Load in GSS Data, include=TRUE}
data(gss_all, package = "gssr") 

gss_years <- gss_all |> 
  dplyr::filter(
    as.numeric(year) >= GSS_START_YEAR, 
    as.numeric(year) <= GSS_END_YEAR)

available_in_file <- intersect( gss_variables, names(gss_years) )

not_found_in_file <- setdiff( gss_variables, names(gss_years) )

not_found_table <- tibble( requested_variable = not_found_in_file )


gss_analysis <- gss_years |> 
  dplyr::select( 
    year, id, dplyr::all_of(available_in_file) )
```

```{r Step 3, Clean and Prepare Data for Analysis, include=TRUE}
availability_list <- purrr::map( 
  available_in_file, 
  function(v) { 
# Construct the variable symbol dynamically. 
variable_symbol <- rlang::sym(v) 

result <- gss_which_years( 
  gss_all, 
  !!variable_symbol 
  ) 

result %>% dplyr::filter( 
  as.numeric(year) >= GSS_START_YEAR, 
  as.numeric(year) <= GSS_END_YEAR ) %>%
  dplyr::rename( available = !!variable_symbol ) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate( variable = v ) 
 } 
)

availability_long <- purrr::map_dfr( 
  availability_list, identity ) %>%
  dplyr::select( year, variable, available ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate( year = as.numeric(year), available = as.logical(available) ) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange( variable, year )

if (length(not_found_in_file) > 0) { 
  not_found_long <- tidyr::expand_grid( 
    year = seq( GSS_START_YEAR, 
                GSS_END_YEAR, by = 2 ), 
    variable = not_found_in_file ) %>% 
    dplyr::mutate( 
      available = NA 
    ) 
  
availability_long <- dplyr::bind_rows( 
  availability_long, not_found_long ) 
} 

availability_long <- availability_long %>% 
  dplyr::mutate( 
    status = dplyr::case_when( 
      variable %in% not_found_in_file ~ "NOT IN CUMULATIVE FILE", 
      available == TRUE ~ "AVAILABLE", 
      available == FALSE ~ "NOT ASKED", 
      TRUE ~ "UNKNOWN" ) )


#write_csv(availability_long, here("00_rawdata", "GSS_Data", "VariableAvailabilityIndex.csv"))

availability_wide <- availability_long %>% 
  dplyr::select( 
    year, variable, status ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider( 
    names_from = year, values_from = status ) %>% 
  dplyr::arrange(variable)

#write_csv(availability_wide, here("00_rawdata", "GSS_Data", "VariableAvailabilityIndex_Wide.csv"))
```

```{r Step 3, Checking Your Work Before You Set Up Analysis, include=TRUE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Variables to examine
# ------------------------------------------------------------

# Use the variables that actually exist in gss_all.
#
# RACECEN and TRUST replace the previously specified

gss_variables <- c(

  # Employment / job
  "occ10",
  "indus10",
  "wrkstat",
  "prestg10",
  "satjob",

# ------------------------------------------------------------

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. Helper function:
#    Extract labelled values and labels
# ------------------------------------------------------------

get_value_labels <- function(x) {

  labs <- attr(x, "labels")

  if (is.null(labs)) {
    return(NA_character_)
  }

  paste(
    names(labs),
    unname(labs),
    sep = " = ",
    collapse = " | "
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. Helper function:
#    Extract substantive information for one
#    variable/year combination
# ------------------------------------------------------------

inspect_variable_year <- function(data, variable, yr) {

  x <- data %>%
    filter(
      as.numeric(year) == yr
    ) %>%
    pull(all_of(variable))

  # If the variable isn't present or contains no observations
  if (length(x) == 0) {

    return(
      tibble(
        year = yr,
        variable = variable,
        n = 0,
        n_valid = 0,
        n_missing = 0,
        min_value = NA_real_,
        max_value = NA_real_,
        n_unique = 0,
        value_labels = NA_character_,
        variable_label = NA_character_
      )
    )
  }


  # Preserve labelled attributes before coercing.
  value_labels <- get_value_labels(x)

  variable_label <- attr(
    x,
    "label"
  )

  # Numeric version for diagnostics.
  x_numeric <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(x)
  )

  # GSS missing values are generally represented by labelled
  # values. We don't want those counted as substantive values.
  #
  # labelled::is_tagged_na() catches tagged missing values.
  # haven::zap_missing() removes labelled missing values.

  x_clean <- suppressWarnings(
    haven::zap_missing(x)
  )

  x_clean_numeric <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(x_clean)
  )

  valid_values <- x_clean_numeric[
    !is.na(x_clean_numeric)
  ]


  tibble(
    year = yr,
    variable = variable,

    n = length(x),

    n_valid = length(valid_values),

    n_missing = sum(
      is.na(x_clean_numeric)
    ),

    min_value = ifelse(
      length(valid_values) > 0,
      min(valid_values),
      NA_real_
    ),

    max_value = ifelse(
      length(valid_values) > 0,
      max(valid_values),
      NA_real_
    ),

    n_unique = length(
      unique(valid_values)
    ),

    value_labels = value_labels,

    variable_label = ifelse(
      is.null(variable_label),
      NA_character_,
      variable_label
    )
  )
}


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. Create year × variable diagnostic table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gss_harmonization_long <- purrr::map_dfr(
  available_variables,
  function(v) {

    purrr::map_dfr(
      seq(
        gss_start_year,
        gss_end_year,
        by = 1
      ),
      function(y) {

        inspect_variable_year(
          data = gss_years,
          variable = v,
          yr = y
        )

      }
    )

  }
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 8. Identify waves in which variable was actually observed
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gss_harmonization_long <- gss_harmonization_long %>%
  mutate(
    status = case_when(

      n == 0 ~ "NOT IN WAVE",

      n_valid == 0 ~ "NO VALID OBSERVATIONS",

      TRUE ~ "AVAILABLE"
    )
  )


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 9. Save detailed diagnostic table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

write_csv(
  gss_harmonization_long,
  here(
    "00_rawdata",
    "GSS_Data",
    "GSS_Harmonization_Long.csv"
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 10. Create a compact table of substantive coding
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gss_coding_table <- gss_harmonization_long %>%
  filter(
    status == "AVAILABLE"
  ) %>%
  select(
    variable,
    year,
    n_valid,
    min_value,
    max_value,
    n_unique,
    variable_label,
    value_labels
  ) %>%
  arrange(
    variable,
    year
  )


write_csv(
  gss_coding_table,
  here(
    "00_rawdata",
    "GSS_Data",
    "GSS_Coding_By_Year.csv"
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 11. Compare each wave's coding to the previous
#     available wave
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gss_coding_changes <- gss_coding_table %>%
  arrange(
    variable,
    year
  ) %>%
  group_by(
    variable
  ) %>%
  mutate(

    previous_year = lag(year),

    previous_labels = lag(
      value_labels
    ),

    previous_min = lag(
      min_value
    ),

    previous_max = lag(
      max_value
    ),

    previous_n_unique = lag(
      n_unique
    ),

    labels_changed = case_when(

      is.na(previous_labels) ~ NA,

      value_labels != previous_labels ~ TRUE,

      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),

    range_changed = case_when(

      is.na(previous_min) ~ NA,

      min_value != previous_min |
        max_value != previous_max ~ TRUE,

      TRUE ~ FALSE
    ),

    number_of_values_changed = case_when(

      is.na(previous_n_unique) ~ NA,

      n_unique != previous_n_unique ~ TRUE,

      TRUE ~ FALSE
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 12. Save year-to-year comparison
# ------------------------------------------------------------

write_csv(
  gss_coding_changes,
  here(
    "00_rawdata",
    "GSS_Data",
    "GSS_Year_to_Year_Coding_Changes.csv"
  )
)


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 13. Create a simplified "needs inspection" table
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gss_needs_inspection <- gss_coding_changes %>%
  filter(
    labels_changed == TRUE |
      range_changed == TRUE |
      number_of_values_changed == TRUE
  ) %>%
  select(
    variable,
    year,
    previous_year,

    labels_changed,
    range_changed,
    number_of_values_changed,

    previous_labels,
    value_labels,

    previous_min,
    min_value,

    previous_max,
    max_value,

    previous_n_unique,
    n_unique
  )


write_csv(
  gss_needs_inspection,
  here(
    "00_rawdata",
    "GSS_Data",
    "GSS_Variables_Needing_Inspection.csv"
  )
)

gss_needs_inspection

)

variables_with_changes <- gss_needs_inspection %>%

message(
  "00_rawdata/GSS_Data/GSS_Coding_By_Year.csv"
)

message(

)

message(
  "00_rawdata/GSS_Data/GSS_Variables_Needing_Inspection.csv"
)
```
